title: Facet Theory and Regional Partitions
text: Facet Theory (FT) meta-approach empirical research orignally proposed Louis Guttman (1957, 1959, 1965) since developed many others (Borg & Shye, 1995; Canter, 1985; Guttman & Greenbaum, 1998; Shye, 1998, 1999; Shye, Elizur & Hoffman, 1994). strongly advise acquire basic understanding FT using package, example Shye (1998). essential step FT applications Multidimensional Scaling (MDS) similarities/distances; introductions see Borg Groenen (2005), also refer vignettes smacof package, installed using facpart. current version package can installed github. recommend load packages facpart smacof parallel. Assume studying domain (e. g., intelligence), measure set items domain, say intelligence test items. Based theory, item can classified according elements facet, defining aspect domain study. respect intelligence items, typical facet modality (symbol system) test item, elements verbal, numerical, figural. Thus, test item mapped onto exactly one categories. theory assumed confirmed facet elements can identified geometrical patterns empirical space constructed measurements items. canonical approach submit correlations among items multidimensional scaling procedure. result obtain 2-dimensional (higher dimensional) configurations points (= items), highly correlated items close , items small negative correlations farther apart. configuration serves starting point search patterns according theoretical classification faceted definition. simple pattern might items belonging specific category (e. g., verbal items) close vicinity, apart items different category. separation can detected, theory must modified. Methods factor analysis cluster analysis traditionally used find patterns correlations. However, patterns emphasized FT called regional partitions, difficult detect traditional methods, . Three types partitions commonly distinguished: Axial partition: categories separated straight parallel lines (axes). Radial partition: categories separated circles different radii, emanating center. Angular partition: categories separated lines different angles common origin. become clear examples . facpart package provides functions search best fitting partitions.

title: Facet Theory Partitioning of 2D Configurations
text: facpart package functions build Facet Theory. helps partition 2-dimensional point configurations (multidimensional-scaling output) according typical facet theoretical partition patterns. Three types common partion schemes supported: Axial — parallel separating lines: axialLine(), axialLines() Radial — nested circles ellipses: radialCircle(), radialCircles(), radialEllipse(), radialEllipses() Angular — wedge-shaped sectors: angularPartition() Plus utilities: ellipseInConfig(), inoutEllipse(), mu2()
